# read_model

In [EhOsContract.Contract](contract-dsl.md), section `contract`.

```elixir
read_model name, label
```

Rows projected from events, for queries to read.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-read_model-name"></a>`name` | `atom` | yes |  | The read model's name. |
| <a id="contract-read_model-label"></a>`label` | `String.t` | yes |  | What the business calls it. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-read_model-projects"></a>`projects` | `atom \| list(atom)` | yes |  | The events it projects. |
| <a id="contract-read_model-delivery"></a>`delivery` | `:in_transaction \| :at_least_once` |  |  | When it is updated; `:in_transaction` when left out, which a reaction to an event of another context has to state (X10). |
| <a id="contract-read_model-source"></a>`source` | `String.t` |  |  | Where the read model comes from in the material. |

Inside it: [`field`](#contract-read_model-field).

## read_model.field
